```yaml
name: Claude Auto-Review
on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  claude-review:
    if: |
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && github.event.action == 'opened') ||
      (github.event_name == 'issue_comment' && contains(github.event.comment.body, '@claude review'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

      - name: Claude Auto-Review
        uses: WalletConnect/actions/claude/auto-review@main
        with:
          project_context: |
            # Reown Docs Architecture & Content Structure
            
            This repository contains Mintlify documentation for the Reown ecosystem, focusing on developer guides, API references, and integration documentation for wallet connectivity solutions.
            
            ## Documentation Structure
            - Primary content organized in MDX files within the main documentation directory
            - Technical documentation targeting Web3 developers building wallet integrations
            - Multi-chain support documentation covering various blockchain networks
            - Developer tooling and SDK documentation
            
            ## Domain-Specific Knowledge
            - Web3 development concepts including wallets, signers, and blockchain interactions
            - Multi-chain compatibility requirements and cross-chain communication patterns
            - WalletConnect protocol specifications and implementation details
            - Developer experience best practices for wallet integrations
            
            ## Review Focus Areas
            - Technical accuracy of code examples and API references
            - Clarity and completeness of developer instructions
            - Consistency with existing documentation patterns
            - Proper use of technical terminology
            - Adherence to Reown's official tone of voice
            
            ## Tone of Voice Compliance
            - Refer to the official tone of voice guidance at `reown-tone-of-voice-extract.md`
            - Maintain consistent technical documentation style throughout
            - Ensure all content aligns with Reown's brand voice and messaging standards
          tone_of_voice_file_path: "reown-tone-of-voice-extract.md"
          claude_model: "claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620"
          max_tokens: 4096
          review_process: |
            1. First, analyze the PR against the project context and tone of voice guidelines
            2. Check for technical accuracy and completeness of documentation
            3. Verify adherence to Reown's official tone of voice
            4. Look for consistency with existing documentation patterns
            5. Identify any areas needing improvement or clarification
            6. Provide specific, actionable feedback with clear explanations
          additional_instructions: |
            - Always reference the tone of voice document when evaluating content quality
            - For technical content, verify that examples and code snippets are accurate and functional
            - Ensure all documentation follows Reown's established writing conventions
            - Pay special attention to clarity and accessibility for developers of varying experience levels
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
```
